lines.text: This is Gerald. Gerald is a turkey.
Yesterday was Thanksgiving, so Gerald spent the whole day hiding in a pumpkin.
He survived! Gerald was so happy, he did a little dance.
Then he saw the sign: Black Friday. Everything, fifty percent off.
Gerald had never been shopping. He grabbed a cart.
Turns out, Black Friday crowds are scarier than Thanksgiving.
So Gerald is back in the pumpkin. See you next year, Gerald.
